blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Latent diffusion models now dominate medical image generation, and every such pipeline rests on a tokenizer that compresses images into the latent codes for image generation to operate on. Thereby, the tokenizer choice bounds every downstream task from reconstruction fidelity and generation quality to the representations available for downstream analysis. Yet, medical imaging pipelines routinely utilize tokenizers from natural imaging on the hypothesis that their behavior carries over. However, this is an assumption never tested in the medical imaging regime, where datasets are orders of magnitude smaller and images exhibit far lower inter-sample variance. We present a systematic evaluation of medical image tokenizers evaluating thirty configurations across ten model families on twelve datasets at three compression factors, spanning reconstruction, generation, latent geometry, downstream classification, and memorization. We find that (1) performance on image reconstruction and generation strongly correlate, unlike prior reports on natural images; (2) modern tokenizers use nearly all of their codebook entries, but still leave most of the latent space unused; (3) training-set memorization is mild and is further suppressed by stronger latent space compression; and (4) discrete quantization can largely preserve downstream classification, with lookup-free schemes being the main exception. † † To foster research in this direction, we will open-source the framework and all models upon acceptance.
blocks.zh: 后期传播模型现在主导着医疗图像的生成,每一个这样的管道都依赖于一种将图像压缩成潜在代码的示意剂,以便图像生成运行. 因此,象征性的选择将每一个下游任务从重建的忠诚和生成质量,到可供下游分析的表述。 然而,医疗成像管道通常使用自然成像中的标致剂,其假设是其行为延续。 然而,这是医学成像系统中从未测试过的一种假设,即数据集数量级较小,图像的样本间差异要小得多。 我们对医疗图像标注器进行了系统评估,对10个模型家庭的30个配置进行了评估,这些组合基于三个压缩系数,包括重建、生成、潜在几何、下游分类和记忆。 我们认为,(1) 图像重建和生成的性能密切相关,与以往关于自然图像的报告不同;(2) 现代标致器几乎使用其所有代码簿条目,但仍留下大部分潜在空间未使用;(3) 培训设定的记忆轻而易举,受到更强潜在空间压缩的进一步抑制;(4) 离散的量化可以在很大程度上保持下游分类,无望方案是主要例外。 † 为了促进这方面的研究,我们将在接受后开放框架和所有模型。

blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Method Overview. We take quantizers out of the library and evaluate them on diverse medical imaging datasets to study whether prevalent assumptions from natural imaging transfer to the medical domain.
blocks.zh: 图1:方法概览。 我们从图书馆中取出量子,用不同的医学成像数据集来评价它们,研究从自然成像转移到医学领域的普遍假设.

blocks.en: Medical imaging faces persistent challenges: limited data hinders generalization [ 1 ] , expert annotations are costly [ 2 ] , and strict privacy regulations constrain data sharing [ 3 , 4 ] . Generative AI offers a compelling path forward, enabling synthetic augmentation, report-to-image synthesis, and latent compression for efficient analysis. Generative models have become dominant across a wide range of medical imaging applications [ 5 , 6 ] , including MRI reconstruction [ 7 , 8 ] , 3D CT and MRI generation [ 4 , 9 , 10 ] , chest X-ray synthesis from radiology reports [ 11 , 12 ] , controllable lesion editing [ 13 ] , pathology and dermatology synthesis [ 14 , 15 , 16 , 17 ] , retinal imaging [ 18 , 19 , 20 ] , and cell morphology modeling [ 21 , 22 ] . Across all of these fields, generation is built almost exclusively on diffusion over a continuous latent, while autoregressive and discrete-token models remain comparatively rare and task-specific [ 23 , 24 , 25 , 26 ] . That latent is produced by a tokenizer , which compresses high-dimensional images into the compact space on which the generator operates. Its choice bounds everything from downstream task performance to generation quality, yet most medical pipelines adopt off-the-shelf quantizers without systematic justification, transferring conclusions from natural imaging.
blocks.zh: 医学成像面临着长期的挑战:有限的数据阻碍泛化[1],专家说明昂贵[2],严格的隐私条例限制数据共享[3,4]. Generative AI提供了一条令人信服的前进道路,使合成增强、报告到图像的合成和潜在的压缩成为有效分析的基础。 遗传模型在一系列广泛的医学成像应用[5,6]中,包括核磁共振重建[7,8],3D CT和核磁共振生成[4,9,10],放射报告中的胸部X射线合成[11,12],可控损伤编辑[13],病理学和皮肤学合成[14,15,16,17],视网膜成像[18,19,20],细胞形态模型[21,22],都变得占主导地位. 在所有这些领域中,代代几乎完全建立在持续潜伏的传播之上,而自旋式和离散式模型则仍然相对罕见,并有具体的任务[23、24、25、26]。 将高维图像压缩到发电机运行的紧凑空间。 其选择将一切从下游任务性能到生成质量,然而大多数医疗管道在没有系统理由的情况下采用现成的量子,从自然成像中转移结论.

blocks.en: In this paper, we study tokenizers as substrates for latent diffusion, which underpins most medical generative pipelines, and challenge the prevailing approach, which carries over assumptions from natural images, and question this transfer, which remains understudied. The first is that reconstruction quality is a poor proxy for generation quality, with recent work instead attributing generation performance to global semantic information and spatial structure in the latent space [ 27 , 28 , 29 , 30 ] . The second is that a healthy codebook, having high utilization and no collapse, signals an expressive latent space [ 31 , 32 , 33 , 34 ] leading to improved generation performance. Both were established on ImageNet-scale natural images, but medical data occupy a fundamentally different statistical regime: collections are small and highly repetitive, images of the same organ share a global layout and differ only in subtle, localized detail, and the diagnostically meaningful signal often lives in fine-grained, high-frequency texture [ 35 ] , such as a faint lesion, that a tokenizer must preserve exactly. With less data to learn from, lower variation between samples, and a narrower margin for error , conclusions drawn from natural images may not transfer cleanly to medical imaging. In consequence, we challenge the current practice and call for a careful re-examination before they are relied upon in this domain.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们研究了作为潜在扩散的底物的示意剂,这是大多数医疗基因管道的基础,并对普遍的方法提出了挑战,这种方法承载着来自自然图像的假设,并对这种转移提出质疑,而这种转移仍然没有得到充分的研究。 第一,重建质量是生成质量的劣质代名词,最近的工作将生成性能归因于潜在空间中的全球语义信息和空间结构[27、28、29、30]。 第二,健康的密码手册,使用率高,没有崩溃,表明潜在的空间[31、32、33、34],从而提高了发电性能。 两者都是在ImageNet尺度的自然图像上建立的,但医学数据占据了根本不同的统计制度:收集量小且高度重复,同一器官的图像共享全球布局,只在微妙,局部的细节上有所不同,诊断有意义的信号往往生活在细微的,高频的纹理[35],如微弱的损伤,一个标致剂必须精确保存. 由于需要学习的数据较少,样品之间的差异较小,误差幅度较小,从自然图像中得出的结论可能不会干净地转移到医学成像上。 因此,我们质疑目前的做法,并呼吁在依靠这些做法之前对其进行认真的重新审查。

blocks.en: Medical imaging raises two additional concerns that natural image tokenizers were never designed to address. First, synthetic medical data is valuable mainly because it protects patient privacy , but that benefit disappears if the model memorizes and reproduces real patients [ 3 , 36 ] . Whether the tokenizer’s compression bottleneck affects this leakage has not yet been studied. Moreover, the tokens are rarely an end in itself: the same compressed representation is routinely reused for downstream clinical tasks such as classification, detection, and retrieval [ 37 , 38 ] , and increasingly serves as the input to multimodal and medical foundation models [ 39 , 23 , 24 , 40 ] , so whether quantization erases class-discriminative structure becomes a central criterion for selecting a tokenizer. Thus, compared to natural image tokenizers, the medical domain prioritizes two distinct goals over perfect pixel reconstruction: the latent representation must preserve the critical diagnostic features used by clinicians, and the subsequent generator must not compromise privacy by memorizing and reproducing exact patient scans. In this work we aim to close this gap. Our contributions are:
blocks.zh: 医疗成像引起了另外两个问题,即自然图像标致剂从未设计用于解决。 首先,合成医学数据之所以有价值,主要是因为它保护了病人的隐私,但如果模型能记住和复制真正的病人[3,36],那么这个好处就消失了. 尚未研究过此缩写器的压缩瓶颈是否影响这一渗漏。 此外,这些标志本身很少是目的:同样的压缩表示方式经常被重复用于下游的临床任务,如分类、检测和检索[37、38],并日益成为多式联运和医疗基础模型[39、23、24、40]的投入,因此量化是否消除阶级歧视结构成为选择标志剂的核心标准。 因此,与自然图像示意剂相比,医学领域优先考虑两个截然不同的目标,而不是完美的像素重建:潜在表现必须保留临床医生使用的关键诊断特征,随后的生成者不得通过记忆和复制准确的病人扫描而损害隐私. 在这项工作中,我们的目标是缩小这一差距。 我们的贡献是:

blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: We benchmark all tokenizers within a single autoencoding architecture [ 41 ] , the de facto autoencoder underlying latent diffusion, ensuring our findings remain representative of deployed medical pipelines. We vary only the quantization module, holding the encoder, decoder, training budget, and data fixed. We first describe this shared autoencoder and the quantizers we plug into it ( Sec. 3.1 ), then the generative model trained on the resulting latents ( Sec. 3.2 ).
blocks.zh: 我们以一个单一的自动编码架构作为基准,将所有显示器作为潜在传播的事实上的自动编码器,确保我们的调查结果仍然能代表部署的医药管道。 我们只改变量化模块, 持有编码器,解码器, 培训预算和数据固定。 我们首先描述了这个共享的自动编码器和我们插进去的量子(第3.1节),然后对由此产生的潜伏物进行了基因模型的培训(第3.2节)。

blocks.en:
To assess each tokenizer as a generative substrate, we freeze the trained autoencoder and fit a single diffusion model in its continuous pre-quantization latent z e z_{e} , rather than training an autoregressive transformer over the discrete z q z_{q} . by state-of-the-art medical latent-diffusion systems [ 4 , 63 ] . blocks.en: Conditioning. We instantiate ϵ θ \epsilon_{\theta} as a DiT-B/2 transformer [ 65 ] . Beyond the diffusion timestep t t , the network is conditioned on two discrete signals: the class label y y and the source-dataset index s s , the latter through a learned dataset embedding that augments DiT’s standard timestep and class embeddings, so a single network is shared across all twelve datasets. blocks.en: 4.1 Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 设置

blocks.en: We benchmark eight discrete quantization families: VQGAN [ 43 ] , SimVQ [ 34 ] , SimQINCo [ 54 ] , RQVAE [ 55 ] , DiVeQ [ 49 ] , SF-DiVeQ [ 49 ] , LFQ [ 52 ] , and BSQ [ 53 ] , together with continuous AEKL [ 57 ] and soft SoftVQ [ 46 ] baselines. Each method is trained at three spatial compression factors f ∈ { 4 , 8 , 16 } f\in\{4,8,16\} on the twelve 2D datasets of the MedMNIST+ collection [ 66 ] at their native 224 × 224 224\times 224 resolution resulting in over 700,000 expert-labeled clinical images spanning pathology, radiology, dermatology, ophthalmology, and microscopy, with multi-class, multi-label, and ordinal classification tasks.
blocks.zh: 我们以8个独立的量化家庭为基准:VQGAN [43]、SimVQ [34]、SimQINCo [54]、RQVAE [55]、DiVeQ [49]、SF-DiVeQ [49]、LFQ [52]和BSQ [53],以及连续的AEKL [57]和软软VQ [46]基线。 每种方法都通过三种空间压缩因子f { 4, 8, 16}f\ in 4, 8, 16}在MedMNIST+收集的十二个2D数据集[66]上,按其原生的224× 224\时的224分辨率进行训练,结果有超过70万个专家标注的临床图像,跨越病理学,放射学,皮肤学,眼科,和微镜学,具有多级,多标签,和普通分类任务.

blocks.en:
Following Sec. 3 , every tokenizer uses the identical encoder-decoder backbone, loss weights, and training
schedule; only the quantizer and compression factor vary, so all observed differences are attributable to the quantization scheme. Both stages, the tokenizer and its DiT-B/2 generator, are trained on 2 × \times NVIDIA H100 GPUs for two days each. For image generation, we use 100 sampling steps on a linear schedule, following [ 64 ] .
blocks.zh:
第3条之后,每个标语器都使用相同的编码器-解码器主干线、减重和培训
调度;只有定量和压缩系数不同,所以所有观测到的差异都归因于定量方案. 两个阶段,代号器和它的DiT-B/2生成器,都接受2×\times NVIDIA H100 GPU的培训,每台2天. 对于图像生成,我们使用100个采样步骤在一个线性时间表上,遵循[64].

blocks.en: 4.2 Reconstruction and Generation
blocks.zh: 4.2 重建和世代

blocks.en:
We evaluate each tokenizer in two regimes. For reconstruction , we encode and decode every test image and report PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS [ 58 ] , and reconstruction-FID (rFID) against the ground truth using torch-fidelity [ 67 ] . For generation , we freeze the autoencoder, train a single DiT-B/2 diffusion model [ 65 ] on its continuous latents ( Sec. 3.2 ), sample per dataset as many images as its test split (conditioned on the dataset and, where applicable, class embedding to match the test-split class distribution) and report
generation-FID (gFID). Since both FIDs use an ImageNet-trained Inception-V3 backbone that is poorly calibrated to medical images, we additionally report FMD , which swaps this backbone for the benchmark’s official per-dataset ResNet-18 baseline classifier [ 66 ] (head removed) so the distance is measured in a feature space tuned to each dataset. We compute it in both regimes as a domain-aware counterpart to rFID and gFID.

blocks.en: 4.6 Memorization
blocks.zh: 4.6 记名

blocks.en:
To test whether a tokenizer’s bottleneck leaks training data, we adopt a nearest-neighbor replication test in the spirit of Somepalli et al. [ 68 ] . For each (tokenizer, dataset) configuration we embed every generated image and, as a calibrated reference, every held-out test image, and retrieve their nearest neighbors in the full training set. Embeddings come from two complementary encoders: SSCD [ 69 ] , purpose-built for copy detection, and DINOv2 [ 70 ] , which captures higher-level semantic similarity; a configuration is flagged only when both agree.
We report copy-rate , the fraction of generated images whose top-1 training similarity exceeds the 95 95 th percentile of the test-to-train similarity distribution, a per-dataset threshold that makes the real held-out data its own baseline ( ≈ 0.05 \approx 0.05 by construction), so that values above baseline indicate copying beyond what genuinely novel images exhibit. As a complementary view we also report the distance ratio between each generated image’s nearest and its next- k k training neighbors ( k = 50 k{=}50 ), where values near one indicate no single memorized match. We cap each dataset at 10,000 10{,}000 generated images and compare against the complete training split.

blocks.en: 5 Results and Discussion
blocks.zh: 5. 结果和讨论

blocks.en:
Reconstruction and generation performance in medical imaging strongly correlate. Across all configurations, reconstruction metrics are strongly predictive of generation quality: rFID and gFID correlate at r = 0.82 r{=}0.82 with 95 % 95\% bootstrap CI [ 0.77 , 0.86 ] [0.77,0.86] ( B = 10,000 B{=}10{,}000 resamples over n = 360 n{=}360 paired observations; Spearman ρ = 0.81 ​ [ 0.77 , 0.85 ] \rho{=}0.81\,[0.77,0.85] ) ( Fig. 2 ), and PSNR/LPIPS show the same trend (per-method values in Tab. 1 ). Moreover, Appendix A disentangles the correlation by dataset and by compression factor, showing it is not an artifact of pooling since the same relationship holds across each stratum. This contrasts with reported natural-image results, where reconstruction is a poor
proxy for generation [ 27 , 28 , 29 ] . We
conjecture this reflects the distinct statistics of medical data, stronger anatomical priors, lower intra-class variance, and limited texture diversity, which yield latent spaces whose reconstructability and generative modelability move together; whether representation-aligned tokenizers would follow a different regime remains open. This is practically valuable since judging a tokenizer by generation requires training a generator per configuration while reconstruction is free from the autoencoder, the correlation lets practitioners select tokenizers and search architectures using rFID alone, reserving generator training for a shortlist. It further makes reconstruction a legitimate optimization target, since reducing reconstruction error is expected to improve generation.

blocks.en: Decoupled codebook usage and latent geometry. Nearly every modern scheme cures the canonical VQ collapse: as f f grows from 4 4 to 16 16 , VQGAN usage falls from 79 % 79\% to 1.2 % 1.2\% , yet reparameterized (SimVQ, SimQINCo), residual (RQVAE), and lookup-free (LFQ, BSQ) methods all hold ≈ 100 % \approx 100\% utilization ( Fig. 4 ; only SF-DiVeQ and SoftVQ collapse partially). But high usage does not imply an efficient latent space: explicit-codebook methods, even at full utilization , compress their latents onto a thin, anisotropic subspace (stable rank 0.15 0.15 – 0.54 0.54 of d d ), whereas lookup-free ( 0.55 0.55 – 0.87 0.87 ) and continuous ( 0.83 0.83 – 0.97 0.97 ) methods stay near-isotropic. This could be driven by the general quantization scheme, not the data or the gradient estimator: nearest-neighbor lookup lets the encoder collapse onto a low-rank manifold the codebook can cover, and it is no straight-through artifact, since DiVeQ propagates true gradients through the quantizer yet collapses just like the rest. The immediate consequence is definitional: since the encoder packs information into a fraction of the available dimensions, the nominal latent dimensionality overstates how much of the space each tokenizer actually uses. Beyond this, the collapse appears benign; stable rank shows no clear effect on either reconstruction or generation, so we treat it as an intrinsic geometric property of these quantizers and an axis independent of downstream quality rather than a driver of it.

blocks.en: Codebook collapse and misalignment. A joint t-SNE of the pre-quant latents 𝒫 z \mathcal{P}_{z} and the selected codes 𝒞 z \mathcal{C}_{z} ( Fig. 3 ) serves as a more diagnostic read-out of tokenizer quality than codebook usage alone, capturing both how much of the codebook a model uses and how well it places that codebook onto the data manifold. It reveals that usage and geometric alignment with the data are independent axes, and that each family trades them off in a distinct way. Vanilla VQGAN displays the canonical codebook collapse pattern: only a few live codewords concentrate tightly on the densest region of 𝒫 z \mathcal{P}_{z} and reconstruct what they cover at low distortion, but most codewords go unused, leaving most of the latent cloud unreached. Lookup-free schemes (LFQ, BSQ) sit at the opposite extreme: their implicit codebooks spread broadly across the embedding space, yielding nearly full usage but settling far from the data manifold, which translates to high quantization error despite the healthy utilization numbers. Codebook-reparameterization methods fall in between: SimVQ exhibits a usage shift in which some datasets are covered densely while others are left sparse, whereas SimQINCo blankets all twelve datasets uniformly and at lower distortion than SimVQ. The differentiable schemes achieve both wide coverage and low distortion, with DiVeQ attaining the lowest 𝒟 per-bit \mathcal{D}_{\text{per-bit}} among the single-codebook methods; SF-DiVeQ, despite interpolating along codeword segments, does not improve on it here. Residual quantization (RQVAE) attains the lowest distortion overall, though at a higher bit rate ( Tab. S6 ), so its low 𝒟 per-bit \mathcal{D}_{\text{per-bit}} partly reflects a higher operating rate.

A tokenizer that reproduces its training data undermines the privacy argument for synthetic imaging, so we ask whether the tokenizer leaks data. Fig. 5 shows it largely does not: across all 720 720 configurations mean copy-rate stays well below the real-data baseline, and the nearest-neighbor distance ratio remains near one, meaning generated images sit
in generic high-density regions rather than locking onto any single example. Outright replication is rare, so on aggregate the bottleneck withholds identity as required. This is not an underfitting artifact as copy-rate is essentially uncorrelated with generation quality and the few elevated copy-rates come from the best generators ( Fig. S11 ).

blocks.en: The exceptions concentrate on Path and OCT, for partly different reasons ( Tab. S21 ). Path is among the least diverse datasets by every measure (low effective rank, low pairwise distance, high nearest-neighbor similarity), so its near-duplicate scans leave a generator little room for novelty. OCT only looks diverse in raw pixels, where speckle inflates variance; its B-scans share a stereotyped layered structure and stay semantically repetitive. Thus, memorization is rather driven by data than by tokenizer design.

blocks.en: The only design choice that matters is compression: memorization falls steadily as the bottleneck tightens, because a coarser latent simply cannot carry the detail that makes a sample traceable. This is the same trade-off we see on our other axes: the compression that protects privacy also discards diagnostic and representational signal.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
Within our benchmark, medical image tokenization departs from natural-image expectations. The field’s inherited assumptions break: reconstruction predicts generation, a healthy codebook hides a collapsed latent, and
discretization is largely free for both privacy and downstream use. Within this setting, there is no single winner, but a clear practitioner’s guide emerges, and reconstruction remains a lever worth pushing.
blocks.zh:
在我们的基准范围内,医疗形象的标志化偏离了自然形象的期望。 现场的传承假设破解:重建预言生成,健康的代码簿隐藏着崩溃的潜伏,以及
光碟化在隐私和下游使用上基本上都是免费的。 在这一背景下,没有单一的赢家,但出现了明确的执业者指南,重建仍然是值得推动的杠杆。

blocks.en: Limitations and Future Work. Our study covers only 2D medical data. Higher-resolution and volumetric data, where compression and memory constraints differ, remain unexplored. We assess each tokenizer through a continuous-latent diffusion model rather than autoregressive modeling of the discrete codes, with a single fixed DiT-B/2 generator, so generation quality reflects latent fidelity but not code-sequence learnability or generator capacity. Downstream utility is gauged via linear probing, a deliberately simple proxy for richer clinical tasks. Our natural-versus-medical comparison also relies on reported natural-image numbers rather than a matched control, which we leave to future work alongside representation-aligned tokenizers. Looking forward, the decoupling of codebook usage from latent geometry suggests designing quantizers that target the latent-rank axis directly rather than chasing utilization. Finally, our work establishes how medical tokenization departs from the natural-image regime but not yet why ; pinning down the cause, be it data scarcity, low inter-sample variability, limited texture diversity, or strong anatomical priors, is the key open question.
blocks.zh: 限制和今后的工作。 我们的研究只涵盖2D医学数据. 高分辨率和量子数据在压缩和内存限制上存在差异,但仍未加以探讨。 我们通过一个连续的相对扩散模型,而不是对离散代码进行自动递减模型,用一个固定的DiT-B/2生成器来评估每个标定器,因此生成质量反映了潜在的忠诚性,而不是代码序列的可学习性或生成能力。 下游的公用是通过线性探测来测量的,这是用于更丰富的临床任务的刻意简单的代名词. 我们的自然与医学比较还依赖于所报告的自然形象数字,而不是相应的控制,我们把这种控制留给今后的工作,并配以与代表性相匹配的表示器。 展望未来,将密码本的使用与潜在的几何方法脱钩表明,设计了直接瞄准潜在排名轴而不是追求利用的量子。 最后,我们的工作确定了医疗标志化如何偏离自然形象制度,但还不是为什么;确定原因,无论是数据稀缺、样本间差异低、纹理多样性有限或解剖学前科很强,都是关键问题。

blocks.en:
We test training-set replication with a nearest-neighbour copy detector under two
feature spaces: SSCD, purpose-built for copy detection
( Tabs. S22 and S23 ), and DINOv2, which captures
higher-level semantic similarity and validates the SSCD analysis in a richer space
( Tabs. S24 and S25 ). Copy-rates are near
zero almost everywhere, concentrating only in the lowest-variance modalities
(OCT, Path); Fig. S10 shows this is driven by the dataset,
not the quantizer.
